name: bodypart-fusion

cpu.note: measured as the cascade bodypart-cascade@r7-fast end to end, which is how this part is served; A5.2.3e, round 1's four blocks pooled (11,081 scored stacks, 32 and 64 workers), cold on the client (the storage server held these blocks): 5.21 h for the 544,972-stack frame. big-1 on the CPU at 32 workers, read third, ran 34.3 a second (4.42 h). Before the overlap A5.3 measured 19.5 a second (ims-a53-bp). The head alone costs 0.34 ms a stack on one thread (round 5, part 2)
cpu.hardware: 64 cores of an AMD EPYC 9745 host, 256 GB of memory, the archive over NFS 4.2; CPU only; nils-bodypart 0.5.0 (the overlap, its start in the workers), CPU build, torch 2.13.0

limits: New patients, from hospitals and scanners seen in training (round 7: the untouched subjects of iaid, multiple_ms, als, ctrl, broms and nmosd)
Fine mode only: six body_part values; answers at or above 0.897 after the calibration below, abstains below it (0.68 of stacks on round 7 T)
A stack without geometry or without a fingerprint gets no answer (an abstention)
Trained on patient pixels: a site model, never exported, never in a release (record 50 study, section 8)
neck against cervical spine follows G2 as Nima ruled on 2026-09-29; the neck class is rare after it
Runs on the CPU only (LightGBM); a card changes nothing for it

params.combiner: LightGBM 300 trees, lr 0.03, 15 leaves, min 20 per leaf, feature and bagging fraction 0.8, class weights 1/sqrt(n)
params.features: the encoder six log-probabilities (clipped at 1e-6) and round 3 44 header features, with the rules columns

calibration.rule: a cohort with at least 20 read stacks in round 7 (S and T) uses its own temperature, fitted on them; any other uses the global one

training_labels.note: the same rows as the registered label set bodypart-gold-r7 that trained_on names, keyed there by DICOM identity

tested.claim: fine mode on round 7's test T at 0.897: weighted coverage
fine mode on round 7's test T at 0.897: weighted error among answered stacks
fine mode on round 7's test T at 0.897: per-site ECE
brain or spine, model minus rules, at 0.897: the difference and its lower 95 % bound (bar at least -0.02)

intended_use: Propose body_part per MR stack at the site; a proposal at or above the threshold is staged for a person to commit, below it a review item
